title: 第11章 强大威慑力第12章 滴血来认亲
content_zh:
第十一章 强大威慑力
秦不群很生气。
本来在朝中就颇为受气，他的同僚兼上级总是有意无意的给他使袢，让他的仕途最近十多年来屡屡受挫，这也就算了，回到家看到的不是妻和子孝，反而是一屋子的哭哭啼啼。
这到底是怎么回事？秦不群挥了挥衣袖坐下，那边他的正妻已经走了过来，“老爷您可算回来，今天府里被人闹翻天了啊！！你看看我们可怜的衾儿，她的手臂被打的淤青成这样……”
“……？谁来府里闹事？”秦不群刚刚才端起茶杯，听到正妻这么一说，又看到女儿白嫩的手臂上全是青淤，猛然茶杯往桌上狠狠一顿。
“老爷，您要给我们做主啊，你看看那个小混蛋，今天不知道发了什么失心疯，突然把家里的下人全部打了个遍，土毕他们全都被打断了一只手，杜管家的侄子在厨房也被打断了一条腿，这下很多事都没人做了啊，还不止如此，秦晴身为大姐，去找那个小混蛋论理，他竟然把姐姐丢出院子，老爷啊，我们做了什么孽啊，惹来这样一个灾星啊。”二妻也顿时扑了出来，管家杜远碌配合的在旁边低头垂泪。
秦不群震惊了。
“你们说什么？？今天在府中大闹的人，是秦岚那个傻小子？”
“是啊，老爷，就是他。我早说过他和他娘都是扫把星，这果然给我们府里带来了灾祸，老爷，您不能再心软了，直接把他们赶出去吧。”正妻在旁边苦口婆心的劝导，还有府里一众伤者哭哭啼啼的模样，让秦不群心头火起。
“来人，去给我把那个混蛋叫过来！！！如果真是他做的，我今天非好好抽他一顿不可。”秦不群先站起身吼了一句，然后才疑惑的转过身，“他一直什么都不会，你却说他把所有人都打断了手？土毕他们有这么差吗？？十多个大汉打不过一个傻孩子？还有你，衾儿，我没记错的话，你应该是二级战士了吧，会被他打？”
“老爷，你有所不知啊，那个傻子身边不知道什么时候出现了一个实力很强的男人，帮着他打人，我看他长大了，现在勾结外人想谋求府里的财产了。”
妇人之见！！！秦不群不屑的哼了一声，他毕竟还是堂堂朝中大臣，又没有半老不死的，这个时候明显的来夺财产？秦岚是傻子，别人难道也是傻子？？会不会是朝中其他人在下黑手？？
秦岚走进大堂的时候，看到了一大堆熟人，大姐二姐三姐，甚至断了手臂的土毕和断了腿的杜之德都在，他们在旁边哼哼唧唧，对着秦岚露出了仇恨的眼神，当然，秦岚直接无视。
他直接迎面走向了秦不群，随着目光的注视，面前的光幕上也已经出现了秦不群的资料。
秦不群，等级6，统率2，体力58，精力42，内政56，勇武3，智谋18，魅力4，运气7，忠诚14，职位无，官职：星岚帝国礼部内行政使，爵位：子爵，技能无。（秦岚之父，没有什么特殊能力。）
“……”秦岚打量了一下这个素未谋面的父亲，说实话，他对秦不群的印象一点都不好，这个近四十多岁的男人，一脸的刻板不说，最让秦岚反感的却是他没有亲情，不管怎么说，秦岚也是他的儿子，他竟然不闻不顾，任凭他被下人欺负，这是做爹的样子吗？
“这个小混蛋太放肆了，见到父亲也不主动请安，真是个没教养的傻子，有这样的弟弟真让人耻辱。”旁边说话的是三姐秦笉，因为秦晴和秦衾都在秦岚的手中吃亏了，所以没有急着说话，她却不知道。
秦岚于是转头看了她一眼，这一看却看出了大问题。
秦笉，等级2，统率0，体力87，精力35，内政21，勇武38，智谋52，魅力46，运气18，忠诚2，职位无，官职无，爵位无，技能，祝福之拳，力量强化，保护盾，盾牌强化，敏捷术，拳套精通，盾牌精通。（王志远之女，战斗牧师。）
！！！！

王志远之女？？？秦岚不敢置信的瞪大了双眼，这是怎么回事？？他连忙转头看向二姐秦衾和大姐秦晴。
秦衾，等级2，统率0，体力91，精力18，内政11，勇武53，智谋23，魅力45，运气17，忠诚1，职位无，官职无，爵位无，技能，强力攻击，圣愈术，霸体，单手剑精通，盾牌精通，盾技精通，骑术精通。（王志远之女，骑士。）
秦晴，等级3，统率0，体力53，精力89，内政12，勇武13，智谋67，魅力53，运气12，忠诚1，职位无，官职无，爵位无，技能，狂风之击，风璇术，风之防护，风之疾走，风之陷落，心灵防护，咒语吟唱，快速恢复，魔力强化。（魏松飞之女，风系魔法师。）
好吧，这一刻，秦岚真的想笑，而且他也没有压制自己，放声大笑起来，整个大堂之中全是他嚣张的大笑声。
“畜生，你在鬼笑什么？？我问你，你今天做了什么好事？？”秦不群终于怒了，他狠狠的拍了一下桌子。
“畜生？”秦岚的眼神一凝，笑容收起，面上也有了一些冷意。“我是畜生，那你是什么？？畜生他爹？”
“放肆！！”秦不群顿时被气到了，他站起身冲到了秦岚面前，高高扬起的右手，告诉所有人，他想做什么。
“哼！！”夏侯渊本来是站在大厅的门外，但是见到有人胆敢冒犯自己的主公，他健壮的身体直接横了上前，粗布衣服根本掩不住他浑身的霸道气势，秦不群也被吓了一跳，“你是谁？怎么进来的？”
“夏侯渊，退下！”秦岚伸手拍了一下夏侯渊的后背，因为才十六岁的秦岚身高甚至还不及夏侯渊的肩膀。
“是！！主公。”
夏侯渊可不是徐荣那种三流武将，他是三国里的绝对的顶级武将之一，而且因为是曹操的亲将，说他权势滔天也绝对没错，那一身威势是别人想学都学不来的，虽然这里站着的只是名将卡开出的伪夏侯渊，但是从他出现开始，大厅之中的所有人都已经不自觉的闭上了嘴，此刻见到他这样的强者竟然对秦岚无比恭顺，顿时一个个吃惊的瞪大了眼。

Chapter 11 Powerful Deterrence
Qin Buqun was very angry.
He was already quite frustrated in the court, and his colleagues and superiors always tried to trick him intentionally or unintentionally, causing his career to suffer setbacks in the past ten years or so. It didn't matter, when he returned home, instead of seeing a filial wife and son, he saw a roomful of crying people.
What the hell is going on? Qin Buqun waved his sleeves and sat down. His wife had already walked over, "Master, you are back. There was a big commotion in the house today!! Look at our poor quilt, her arms were bruised like this..."
"...? Who is coming to make trouble in the house?" Qin Buqun had just picked up the teacup. Hearing what his wife said, and seeing his daughter's white and tender arms covered with bruises, Qin Buqun suddenly slammed the teacup on the table.
"Master, you have to make the decision for us. Look at that little bastard. He went crazy today. He suddenly beat up all the servants in the family. Tubi and the others all had their hands broken. Housekeeper Du's nephew also had his leg broken in the kitchen. Now many things are gone. People have done it, and that's not all. As the eldest sister, Qin Qing went to argue with that little bastard, and he actually threw her out of the yard. Master, what evil have we done to bring about such a disaster?" The second wife also rushed out immediately, and the housekeeper Du Yuanlu bowed his head and shed tears beside her.
Qin Buqun was shocked.
"What are you talking about?? The person who made a big fuss in the mansion today is that silly boy Qin Lan?"
"Yes, sir, that's him. I've said before that he and his mother are both bad guys, and this has really brought disaster to our house. Sir, you can't be soft-hearted anymore, just drive them out." The wife's earnest advice from the side, and the sight of all the injured people in the house crying, made Qin Buqun feel angry.
"Come on, call that bastard over here!!! If it's really what he did, I have to give him a good beating today." Qin Buqun stood up and yelled, then turned around in confusion, "He has never known anything, but you said he broke everyone's hands? Are they so bad in Tubi?? More than ten big men can't beat a stupid kid? And you, Jian'er, if I remember correctly, you should be a second-level warrior, will you be beaten by him?"
"Master, you don't know something. A very powerful man appeared next to that fool at some time and helped him beat people. I think he has grown up and is now colluding with outsiders to seek property in the house."
A woman's view! ! ! Qin Buqun snorted disdainfully. After all, he was still a high-ranking minister, and he was not immortal. Why would he obviously come to seize property at this time? Qin Lan is a fool, are others also fools? ? Could it be that someone else in the DPRK was behind this? ?
When Qin Lan walked into the lobby, he saw a lot of acquaintances, including the eldest, second and third sisters, and even Tubi who had a broken arm and Du Zhide who had a broken leg. They were groaning and looking at Qin Lan with hatred. Of course, Qin Lan ignored them.
He walked directly towards Qin Buqun, and as he looked, Qin Buqun's information appeared on the light screen in front of him.
Qin Buqun, level 6, command 2, physical strength 58, energy 42, internal affairs 56, bravery 3, resourcefulness 18, charm 4, luck 7, loyalty 14, no position, official position: Internal Administrative Officer of the Xinglan Empire Ministry of Rites, title: Viscount, no skills. (Qin Lan’s father has no special abilities.)
"..." Qin Lan took a look at the father he had never met before. To be honest, his impression of Qin Buqun was not good at all. This man in his late forties had a rigid expression on his face. What disgusted Qin Lan the most was that he had no family ties. After all, Qin Lan was also his son, and he actually ignored him and allowed him to be bullied by his servants. Is this how a father should behave?
"This little bastard is too presumptuous. He doesn't take the initiative to say hello to his father when he sees him., What an uneducated fool, it is shameful to have such a younger brother. "The third sister Qin Jian was speaking next to her. Because both Qin Qing and Qin Yan suffered at the hands of Qin Lan, they were not in a hurry to speak, but she didn't know it.
Qin Lan then turned to look at her, and she saw a big problem.
Qin Yan, level 2, command 0, physical strength 87, energy 35, internal affairs 21, bravery 38, resourcefulness 52, charm 46, luck 18, loyalty 2, no position, no official position, no title, skills, blessed fist, strength enhancement, protective shield, shield enhancement, agility, glove proficiency, shield proficiency. (Daughter of Wang Zhiyuan, combat priest.)
! ! ! !
Wang Zhiyuan’s daughter? ? ? Qin Lan's eyes widened in disbelief, what's going on? ? He quickly turned to look at his second sister Qin Gu and his eldest sister Qin Qing.
Qin quilt, level 2, command 0, physical strength 91, energy 18, internal affairs 11, bravery 53, resourcefulness 23, charm 45, luck 17, loyalty 1, no position, no official position, no title, skills, powerful attack, holy healing, hegemony, one-handed sword proficiency, shield proficiency, shield skill proficiency, riding skill proficiency. (Daughter of Wang Zhiyuan, knight.)
Qin Qing, level 3, command 0, physical strength 53, energy 89, internal affairs 12, bravery 13, resourcefulness 67, charm 53, luck 12, loyalty 1, no position, no official position, no title, skills, wind strike, wind shudder, wind protection, wind rush, wind fall, psychic protection, spell chanting, quick recovery, magic power enhancement. (Wei Songfei’s daughter, wind magician.)
Well, at this moment, Qin Lan really wanted to laugh, and he didn't suppress himself. He laughed loudly, and the whole hall was filled with his arrogant laughter.
"Beast, what are you laughing at? ? Let me ask you, what good thing did you do today? ? "Qin Buqun finally got angry, and he slapped the table hard.
"Beast? "Qin Lan's eyes condensed, his smile disappeared, and there was a bit of coldness on his face. "I am a beast, so who are you? ? His father is a beast? "
"Presumptuous! ! "Qin Buqun was immediately angry. He stood up and rushed to Qin Lan. He raised his right hand high and told everyone what he wanted to do.
"Hmph! ! "Xia Houyuan was originally standing outside the door of the hall, but when he saw someone who dared to offend his lord, his strong body stepped forward directly. His coarse clothes could not hide his domineering aura. Qin Buqun was also shocked, "Who are you? How did you get in? "
"Xia Houyuan, stand down! "Qin Lan reached out and patted Xia Houyuan's back, because Qin Lan, who was only sixteen years old, was not even as tall as Xia Houyuan's shoulders.
"Yes! ! Lord. "
Xia Houyuan is not a third-rate military general like Xu Rong. He is one of the absolute top military generals in the Three Kingdoms. And because he is Cao Cao's personal general, it is absolutely correct to say that he is powerful. His power is something that no one else can learn, even though he is standing here. It was only the fake Xia Houyuan who had been carded by the famous general, but from the moment he appeared, everyone in the hall had unconsciously shut their mouths. Seeing that a strong man like him was extremely respectful to Qin Lan, everyone's eyes widened in surprise.
